properties.Caption: Calculation Order
properties.ToolTip: Specifies an integer to determine the sequence the program must use when tax is calculated.

properties.Caption: Code
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the code you want to assign to this tax jurisdiction. You can enter up to 10 characters, both numbers and letters. It is a good idea to enter a code that is easy to remember.

properties.Caption: Description
properties.ToolTip: Specifies a description of the tax jurisdiction. For example, if the tax jurisdiction code is ATLANTA GA, enter the description as Atlanta, Georgia.

properties.Caption: Report-to Jurisdiction
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the tax jurisdiction you want to associate with the jurisdiction you are setting up. For example, if you are setting up a jurisdiction for Atlanta, Georgia, the report-to jurisdiction is Georgia because Georgia is the tax authority to which you report Atlanta sales tax.

properties.Caption: Unrealized VAT Type
properties.ToolTip: Specifies how to handle unrealized tax, which is tax that is calculated but not due until the invoice is paid.

properties.Caption: Calculate Tax on Tax
properties.ToolTip: Specifies whether to calculate the sales tax amount with the tax on tax principle.

properties.Caption: Adjust for Payment Discount
properties.ToolTip: Specifies whether to recalculate tax amounts when you post payments that trigger payment discounts.

properties.Caption: Code
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the code you want to assign to this tax group.

properties.Caption: Description
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the description of the tax group. For example, if the tax group code is ALCOHOL, you could enter the description Alcoholic beverages.

properties.Caption: Tax Jurisdiction Code
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the tax jurisdiction code for the tax-detail entry.

properties.Caption: Tax Group Code
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the tax group code for the tax-detail entry.

properties.Caption: Tax Type
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the type of tax (Sales Tax or Excise Tax) that applies to the tax-detail entry.

properties.Caption: Maximum Amount/Qty.
properties.ToolTip: Specifies a maximum amount or quantity. The program finds the appropriate tax percentage in either the Tax Below Maximum or the Tax Above Maximum field.

properties.Caption: Tax Below Maximum
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the percentage that will be used to calculate tax for all amounts or quantities below the maximum amount quantity in the Maximum Amount/Qty. field.

properties.Caption: Tax Above Maximum
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the percentage that will be used to calculate tax for all amounts or quantities above the maximum amount quantity in the Maximum Amount/Qty. field.

properties.Caption: Effective Date
properties.ToolTip: Specifies a date on which the tax-detail entry will go into effect. This allows you to set up tax details in advance.

properties.Caption: Code
properties.ToolTip: Specifies a code for the posting group that determines how to calculate and post VAT for customers and vendors. The number of VAT posting groups that you set up can depend on local legislation and whether you trade both domestically and internationally.

properties.Caption: Description
properties.ToolTip: Specifies a description of the posting group that determines how to calculate and post VAT for customers and vendors. The number of VAT posting groups that you set up can depend on local legislation and whether you trade both domestically and internationally.

properties.Caption: Code
properties.ToolTip: Specifies a code for the posting group the determines how to calculate VAT for items or resources that you purchase or sell.

properties.Caption: Description
properties.ToolTip: Specifies a description of the posting group the determines how to calculate VAT for items or resources that you purchase or sell.

properties.Caption: VAT Bus. Posting Group
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the VAT specification of the involved customer or vendor to link transactions made for this record with the appropriate general ledger account according to the VAT posting setup.

properties.Caption: VAT Prod. Posting Group
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the VAT specification of the involved item or resource to link transactions made for this record with the appropriate general ledger account according to the VAT posting setup.

properties.Caption: VAT Calculation Type
properties.ToolTip: Specifies how VAT will be calculated for purchases or sales of items with this particular combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group.

properties.Caption: VAT %
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the relevant VAT rate for the particular combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group. Do not enter the percent sign, only the number. For example, if the VAT rate is 25 %, enter 25 in this field.

properties.Caption: Unrealized VAT Type
properties.ToolTip: Specifies how to handle unrealized VAT, which is VAT that is calculated but not due until the invoice is paid.

properties.Caption: Adjust for Payment Discount
properties.ToolTip: Specifies whether to recalculate VAT amounts when you post payments that trigger payment discounts.

properties.Caption: Sales VAT Account
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the general ledger account number to which to post sales VAT for the particular combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group.

properties.Caption: Sales VAT Unreal. Account
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the general ledger account number to which to post unrealized sales VAT (as calculated when you post sales invoices) using this particular combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group.

properties.Caption: Purchase VAT Account
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the general ledger account number to which to post purchase VAT for the particular combination of business group and product group.

properties.Caption: Purch. VAT Unreal. Account
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the general ledger account number to which to post unrealized purchase VAT (as calculated when you post purchase invoices) using this particular combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group.

properties.Caption: Reverse Chrg. VAT Acc.
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the general ledger account number to which you want to post reverse charge VAT (purchase VAT) for this combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group, if you have selected the Reverse Charge VAT option in the VAT Calculation Type field.

properties.Caption: Reverse Chrg. VAT Unreal. Acc.
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the number of the general ledger account to post amounts for unrealized reverse charge VAT to.

properties.Caption: VAT Identifier
properties.ToolTip: Specifies a code to group various VAT posting setups with similar attributes, for example VAT percentage.

properties.Caption: EU Service
properties.ToolTip: Specifies if this combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group are to be reported as services in the periodic VAT reports.

properties.Caption: VAT Clause Code
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the VAT Clause Code that is associated with the VAT Posting Setup.

properties.Caption: Certificate of Supply Required
properties.ToolTip: Specifies if documents that use this combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group require a certificate of supply.

properties.Caption: Tax Category
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the VAT category in connection with electronic document sending. For example, when you send sales documents through the PEPPOL service, the value in this field is used to populate the TaxApplied element in the Supplier group. The number is based on the UNCL5305 standard.

properties.Caption: Description
properties.ToolTip: Specifies a description of the VAT posting setup

properties.Caption: Blocked
properties.ToolTip: Specifies if this particular combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group is blocked.

properties.Caption: Non-Deductible VAT %
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the percentage of the transaction amount to which VAT is not applied.

properties.Caption: Non-Deductible Purchase VAT Account
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the account associated with the VAT amount that is not deducted due to the type of goods or services purchased.

properties.Caption: Allow Non-Deductible VAT
properties.ToolTip: Specifies whether the Non-Deductible VAT is considered for this particular combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group.

properties.Caption: Auto. Create Tax Details
properties.ToolTip: Specifies that the required tax information is created automatically.

properties.Caption: Non-Taxable Tax Group Code
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the group code for non-taxable sales.

properties.Caption: Currency Code
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the code of the currency on this line.

properties.Caption: Starting Date
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the date on which the exchange rate on this line comes into effect.

properties.Caption: Exchange Rate Amount
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the amounts that are used to calculate exchange rates for the currency on this line.

properties.Caption: Adjustment Exch. Rate Amount
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the amounts that are used to calculate exchange rates that will be used by the Adjust Exchange Rates batch job.

properties.Caption: Relational Currency Code
properties.ToolTip: Specifies how you want to set up the two currencies, one of the currencies can be LCY, for which you want to register exchange rates.

properties.Caption: Relational Exch. Rate Amount
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the amounts that are used to calculate exchange rates for the foreign currency on this line.

properties.Caption: Fix Exchange Rate Amount
properties.ToolTip: Specifies if the currency's exchange rate can be changed on invoices and journal lines.

properties.Caption: Relational Adjmt Exch Rate Amt
properties.ToolTip: Specifies the amounts that are used to calculate exchange rates that will be used by the Adjust Exchange Rates batch job.
